# How to update your portfolio yourself

You can ask Claude to change your website from GitHub, on your computer or the GitHub phone app.
Nothing goes live until you approve it.

## 1. Ask for a change

1. Open https://github.com/Keerthi2000-coder/ECE-Portfolio-2026/issues/new/choose
2. Pick **Ask Claude to change my portfolio**.
3. Write what you want in your own words. Drag in any PDFs or photos.
   Keep `@claude` at the top, because that's what starts Claude.
4. Click **Create**.

Claude replies on the issue within a few minutes and shows its progress.

## 2. Check the preview

When Claude is done it opens a **pull request** (or gives you a **Create PR** link: click it, then **Create pull request**).
After about a minute, a comment appears on the pull request with a **preview link**.
Open it and check the change on your site.

- Something to fix? Comment on the pull request starting with `@claude`, for example
  `@claude make the heading smaller` or `@claude use my exact words: ...`.
  Claude updates it and the preview refreshes.

## 3. Publish

Happy with the preview? On the pull request click **Merge pull request**, then **Confirm merge**.
The live site updates in about a minute: https://keerthi2000-coder.github.io/ECE-Portfolio-2026/

Changed your mind? Click **Close pull request** instead and nothing changes.

## Good to know

- Your reflections, goals and land acknowledgement must be your own words (your originality statement).
  Paste your text and Claude only formats and places it.
- Confidential documents (like the OCT certificate) should not be uploaded: the repo is public.
- Children: only Child A, B...; no names, faces or student numbers.
